title: trackerAttachments
responsibility: Validates attachment listings stored on an item or received from another computer.

inputs.name: trackerAttachments.stored
inputs.description: Stored JSON text or an already parsed list; null and undefined mean none.

inputs.name: trackerAttachmentFields.stored
inputs.description: The same listing source, to be spread into a reply object.

outputs.name: trackerAttachmentListing
outputs.description: Schema of the fields a caller may name: kind, title and the GitHub or https source.

outputs.name: trackerAttachmentSchema
outputs.description: Schema of a stored listing, adding the computed hash id and byte size.

outputs.name: trackerAttachments
outputs.description: The valid listings, or an empty list when anything is unreadable.

outputs.name: trackerAttachmentFields
outputs.description: An object with an attachments field, or an empty object when there are none.
